content.value: A 50 kVA, 4400/220 V transformer has R1= 3.45 Ω and R2= 0.009 Ω. The values of 10 reactances are X₁= 5.20 Ω and $\mathrm { X } _ { 2 } { = } 0 . 0 1 5 \Omega .$ Calculate for the transformer
(i) equivalent resistance as referred to primary
(ii) equivalent resistance as referred to secondary
(iii) equivalent reactance as referred to both primary and secondary
(iv) equivalent impedance as referred to both primary and secondary
(v) total Cu loss using individual resistances of the two windings.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
